mesa: explicitly use shared libgcc. For clang toolchain, we are changing the default for unwinder library from shared library to static library. Since mesa is explicitly requesting the libgcc library, let's explicitly request the share library version to keep the old behavior. There is no functional change here. It just allows us to change the default. Also note that, for Chrome OS, libgcc is mostly not used. It has been replaced by llvm/compiler-rt. The only remaining part in use from libgcc is libgcc_eh (for unwinding). BUG=chromium:972454 TEST=None. No functional change. sensors: split mems_setup in two parts mems_setup is meant to be a boot-time configuration tool. In its initial incarnation, it also included a bunch of useful wrapper classes around libiio, because that was the only logical place they could fit. The plan, however, is to use those same wrapper classes to support other clients of libiio in platform2. So, it makes sense to split mems_setup in two parts at this time: libmems: a library that wraps libiio and provides useful testing mocks and helpers around that, with proper platform2/ ergonomics, and easily accessible by the rest of the codebase. mems_setup: a boot-time configuration tool, solely responsible for initializating the sensors on a ChromeOS device, and the replacement for accelerometer-init.sh. BUG=chromium:969101 TEST=emerge and test mems_setup after the split Change-Id: I13b074804505ab3e730f8e0b054dd48955766c6b Signed-off-by: Enrico Granata <egranata@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1666609 Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Ricky Liang <jcliang@chromium.org>
